quests.name: The Necromancer of Sslathis
quests.offer: Tesarin Moonstrider, a necromancer, works his craft atop a black pyramid in Sslathis, far down the coast south of Freeport, past Hazinak. Kill him and bring me his spellbook. Mind his pet.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Tesarin Moonstrider on top of the black pyramid in Sslathis.
Bring Tesarin's spellbook to Adrwyiel Niteshyre in the wizards' guild.
steps.says: Good riddance. Now Vaelian Wyndsorrow, in the enchanters' guild, the west building on the lake, wants paying. Go to him.

steps.journal: Pay Vaelian Wyndsorrow in the enchanters' guild 600 tunar.
steps.says: Adrwyiel's debt is settled. Go back to her.

steps.journal: Return to Adrwyiel Niteshyre.
steps.says: Lutherian, across the room, has your reward.

steps.journal: See Lutherian Dawnsinger, across the room from Adrwyiel.
steps.says: Well done. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/fayspire.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The spellbook is ours (the guide names no item); Tesarin's pet is not in. The guide's Vaelan Wyndsorrow and Lutherian Doomsinger are the game's Vaelian Wyndsorrow and Lutherian Dawnsinger; its bard's and paladin's and cleric's Bracers are their level 17 sets'. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the warrior, shadowknight, monk, shaman, magician, necromancer, alchemist, who get the experience alone. Bracers of Brilliance is made here (no item has the name), with the look and stats of Bracers of Radiance.

quests.name: The Scribe's Inks
quests.offer: I need two things for my work: embalming fluid, from the ancient mummies in the desert south-west of the city, and cured drake's blood from Talya Montar in Highpass.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill ancient mummies in north-western Ro, in the hills north of the human camp, for embalming fluid.
Buy cured drake's blood from Talya Montar on the second floor of the Highpass keep (600 tunar).
steps.says: Drake's blood, well cured.

steps.journal: Bring the embalming fluid and the cured drake's blood to Scribe Cathassa.
steps.says: Just what I needed. Draeg Kuthra has your reward: out my east door, south, and the first door east.

steps.journal: See Draeg Kuthra, out the east door, south, and the first door east.
steps.says: Cathassa sent you? This is yours.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/freeport.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's necromancers' Bracers of Shadow are their set's Bracer of the Shadow, its bards' Gloves the Gloves of Harmony; the ancient mummies are the server's mummies of Ro (FrontiersForge's Ancient Mummy stands where one of them does). The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the magician, alchemist, who get the experience alone. Bracers of Brilliance is made here (no item has the name), with the look and stats of Bracers of Radiance.

quests.name: Froglok Liver
quests.offer: Nungzsh hungry. Want liver of froglok questor, from swamp round troll war camp north on road. And sauce from Thuldreksh. Bring both.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill froglok questors in the marshes round the troll war camp north of Grobb.
Buy sauce from Thuldreksh in the shamans' guild, through the door in the great tree (600 tunar).
steps.says: Sauce. Good on everything.

steps.journal: Bring the froglok questor liver and the sauce to Nungzsh by the well.
steps.says: Mmm. Argash behind well have thing for you.

steps.journal: See Argash, behind the well by Nungzsh.
steps.says: Nungzsh happy. You take.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/grobb.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Offered to the classes the guide gives a reward (cleric, necromancer, rogue, shadowknight, shaman); its evil-only note is not a gate here (the server sets no race's standing apart). The liver and sauce are the guide's, by these names ours. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Boots of the Silent Strider is made here (no item has the name), with the look and stats of Boots of Nature's Ward.

quests.name: Bloodmaw
quests.offer: A werewolf called Bloodmaw prowls the hills by Goldfeather Eyrie, north of Moradhim. Kill it and bring me a fang. And take this letter to Nuvak McGregor at Diren's Hold.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Bloodmaw in the hills by the ramps north-west of Goldfeather Eyrie.
Give Olga's letter to Nuvak McGregor at Diren's Hold, and buy his cleansing solution (600 tunar).
steps.says: Olga's hand, I would know it anywhere. Here is the solution.

steps.journal: Bring Bloodmaw's fang and the cleansing solution to Olga McBryne.
steps.says: Good. Udin Kalenn, along the row of buildings on the east side, has your reward.

steps.journal: See Udin Kalenn along the row of buildings on the east side of Halas.
steps.says: Olga said you would come.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/halas.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Novak Mcgregor and Undin Kalenn are the game's Nuvak McGregor and Udin Kalenn; it does not say to go back to Olga before Udin, but she sends you on. The fang and the letter are the guide's; the bards' Boots are the Boots of Harmony. The guide's good-only and dark elf notes are not a gate here. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the shadowknight, monk, magician, necromancer, alchemist, who get the experience alone.

quests.name: Ulria Veshiue
quests.offer: My sister Ulria has turned to darkness. She hides south, through the south door, across the bridge, upstairs in the building there. End it, and bring me her locket.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Ulria Veshiue upstairs in the building across the bridge south of Highbourne.
Buy a cleansing solution from Lwudras Belladuo outside the church (600 tunar).
steps.says: A cleansing solution. Use it well.

steps.journal: Bring Ulria's locket and the cleansing solution to Indoran Veshiue.
steps.says: It is over, then. Veldruin Foamstalker has your reward.

steps.journal: See Veldruin Foamstalker.
steps.says: Indoran asked me to give you this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/highbourne.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Indoren Veshine, Ulira Veshine and Lwudras Belladuos are the game's Indoran Veshiue, Ulria Veshiue and Lwudras Belladuo. The locket is ours (the guide names no item). Its dark elf note is not a gate here. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the shadowknight, monk, bard, magician, necromancer, wizard, alchemist, who get the experience alone.

quests.name: Grave Silk
quests.offer: Bring me three grave silks from the grave spiders in the rat and spider tomb in Hagley, and 600 tunar for my trouble, and I will see you outfitted.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill grave spiders in the tomb in Hagley for three grave silks.
Bring three grave silks and 600 tunar to Holthis D'Worok by the Highpass coach.
steps.says: Fine silk. This will fit you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/highpass.json, step 1 and its Class Rewards (Part 1) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The necromancers' Leggings and Tunic of Shadow are their set's Leggings of the Shadow and Robe of Shadow, the wizards' Robe the Robe of Insight. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the ranger, paladin, monk, bard, rogue, druid, magician, alchemist, who get the experience alone.

quests.name: Courier Svex
quests.offer: There is more. Informant Durin, north of the Grobb coach, sells what he knows. Pay him, and do what he tells you.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Pay Informant Durin, north of the Grobb coach, 500 tunar.
steps.says: Courier Svex carries four scrolls along the road. Kill him and take them to Holthis.

steps.journal: Kill Courier Svex on his road and take his scrolls.
Bring Svex's scrolls to Holthis D'Worok.
steps.says: Exactly what I wanted. Juresi, beside me, has your reward.

steps.journal: See Juresi D'Worok, beside Holthis.
steps.says: My brother keeps his word. Here.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/highpass.json, steps 2 to 4 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Durin is Informant Durin, the NPC next to Holthis Juresi D'Worok; the four scrolls are one item. Its 263,426 experience is the guide's; the class-specific item is not named and is left out.

quests.name: Deidre IV
quests.offer: Deidre IV has gone wild. Out the east gate, south-east over the mountain's shoulder, to the clockwork village. She roams the flats there. Bring me a cog of hers.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Deidre IV near the clockwork village south-east of Klick`Anon.
Buy intense grease from Weedle Zinktink at the inn (600 tunar).
steps.says: Intense grease. Very intense.

steps.journal: Bring Deidre IV's cog and the intense grease to Ludvick Undogeem.
steps.says: Now she can be mended. My brother Aldrek, in the rogues' guild, has your reward.

steps.journal: See Aldrek Undogeem, Ludvick's brother, in the rogues' guild.
steps.says: Ludvick said you would come.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/klick-anon.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Ludvick, Vuldrek and Weedle Zintink are the server's Ludvick Undogeem, Aldrek Undogeem and Weedle Zinktink; the bards' Breast Plate is the Tunic of Harmony, the paladins' Greaves the Greaves of Virtue. The cog is ours. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the monk, magician, alchemist, who get the experience alone. Ring of Brilliance is made here (no item has the name), with the look and stats of Ring of Shadow.

quests.name: Murien's Brew
quests.offer: I brew something special and I lack two things: nectar from Nadrin Stoneblood, down the ramps, and the poison sac of an erollisian viper from the Druk, south of the Fayspires.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill the erollisian viper east of the river in the Druk, south of the Fayspires.
Buy nectar from Nadrin Stoneblood, down the ramps (600 tunar).
steps.says: Sweetest nectar in the mountain.

steps.journal: Bring the poison sac and the nectar to Murien Stonebeard on the tavern's second floor.
steps.says: Perfect. Mildred Blightforge has your reward.

steps.journal: See Mildred Blightforge.
steps.says: Murien's brew must be ready. This is for you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/moradhim.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Murian is the game's Murien Stonebeard; the bards' Necklace is the Amulet of Harmony, the monks' Disciple's Helm the Helm of the Disciple, the necromancers' Sash of Shadows the Sash of the Shadow. The warriors' Soldier's Belt is left out: the only item of that name is a level 60 belt. Its dark elf note is not a gate here. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the warrior, magician, alchemist, who get the experience alone. Pendant of Malice is made here (no item has the name), with the look and stats of Soldier's Pendant.

quests.name: The Ceremony
quests.offer: The ceremony wants a ceremonial dagger, from Adrassya in the basement of the Spurned Enclave, and a vial of blood from a wandering priestess in Blakedown. Bring both.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Buy a ceremonial dagger from Adrassya V'Kar in the Spurned Enclave's basement (600 tunar).
steps.says: Sharp, and blessed. Mind your fingers.

steps.journal: Kill the wandering priestess who roams Blakedown for a vial of blood.
Bring the ceremonial dagger and the vial of blood to Tanadril N`Thael.
steps.says: Neriak thanks you. Denouncer G`Efia, at the base of the guild, has something for you.

steps.journal: See Denouncer G`Efia at the base of the clerics' guild.
steps.says: Tanadril spoke of you. Go well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/neriak-nektulos.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Adrassya N'Var is the game's Adrassya V'Kar. The faction is the guide's (+100 Citizens of Neriak, +10 Indigo Brotherhood). G`Efia's class-specific item is not named and is left out. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give.

quests.name: The Shadowhand Receipt
quests.offer: Captain Drailis in Forkwatch has been asking after the Shadowhand bandits. Go to him, and do what he asks.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Find Captain Drailis in Forkwatch.
steps.says: The Shadowhand bandits in the Qeynos farmlands carry receipts for stolen goods. Bring one to Nanibar Volsweath in Wyndhaven.

steps.journal: Kill Shadowhand bandits in the Qeynos farmlands for a receipt.
Take the receipt to Nanibar Volsweath in Wyndhaven, and buy his blade (600 tunar).
steps.says: So that is where it went. Take the blade to Laressa.

steps.journal: Bring the blade to Laressa Nevar in the paladins' guild.
steps.says: Justice done. Kaelron Uldaras has your reward.

steps.journal: See Kaelron Uldaras.
steps.says: Laressa told me. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/qeynos.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Drailis is Captain Drailis, its Nanigar Volsweath the server's Nanibar Volsweath; the receipt and blade are ours by name. The monks' Disciple's Sash is the Sash of the Disciple, the warriors' Ring the Soldier's Insignia. Its dark elf note is not a gate here. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the shadowknight, bard, wizard, alchemist, who get the experience alone. Ring of the Silent Strider is made here (no item has the name), with the look and stats of Ring of Guarding.

quests.name: Tesht'uzu
quests.offer: A goblin called Tesht'uzu wears an amulet that is not his, in Runnyeye. North out of Highpass, then the mountains west, then the road north. Kill him and bring it back.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Kill Tesht'uzu in Runnyeye and take the amulet.
Buy a vial of Karana's tears from Lyliann Brindlespur in south-west Rivervale (600 tunar).
steps.says: Karana's tears. Keep them from the sun.

steps.journal: Bring the amulet and Karana's tears to Syrus Galestride in the druids' guild.
steps.says: You did it. Ren Deeppockets has your reward.

steps.journal: See Ren Deeppockets.
steps.says: Syrus said you would come. Here.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/17/rivervale.json, the walkthrough (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Syrus Gilstride is the game's Syrus Galestride; the bards' Sword is the Blade of Harmony, the rangers' Sword of Nature's Ward the Blade of Nature's Ward. Its dark elf note is not a gate here. The experience is Highpass's 263,426, the one figure the level 17 guides give. Every class may take it (the guide's All/All); the guide lists no reward for the shadowknight, monk, shaman, magician, necromancer, alchemist, who get the experience alone. Crook of the Gladestrider is made here (no item has the name), with the look and stats of Gloomtwig Cudgel.
